summary: The PR introduces a large number of new files that seem to be a complete reimplementation of the requests library, rather than addressing the specific issue of the Content-Length header in GET requests.

issues.description: The PR introduces a large number of new files that seem to be a complete reimplementation of the requests library, rather than addressing the specific issue of the Content-Length header in GET requests. This is a significant scope creep and does not align with the linked issue.
